To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a SPARQL-to-Gremlin translator, Gremlinator, which translates SPARQL SELECT statements to Gremlin path traversal statements.
we have developed a translator from SPARL to Gremlin, which allows querying graph data stores with a standard query language.
we have developed a translator that converts SPARQL queries into Gremlin traversals, allowing a user to query any graph database using SPARQL.
In summary, our research is concerned with

• Developing a translator that allows SPARQL users to query PG DMSs without having to learn a new GQL • Extending the SPARQL 2013 query benchmark to support PG DMSs • Developing a benchmark for evaluating PG DMSs that supports both RDF and PG queries.

the following research question: Can we use a SPARQL query to query a PG? Our answer is: Yes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Gremlinator is a SPARQL to Gremlin translator for executing SPARQL queries over property graphs.
Gremlinator is the rst translator that supports the conversion of SPARQL queries into Gremlin path traversing expressions.
Gremlinator is a translator from SPARQ to Gremlin that allows a user, well versed in the SPARQL language, to execute SPARQL queries over Graph DMSs that are based on the PG data model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed the rst translator for SPARQL to Gremlin, and we have demonstrated that the translated queries can be used to query graph databases using Gremlin.
we have implemented a translator for SPARQL queries into Gremlin path traversing queries.
Gremlinator translates a SPARQL query into Gremlin path traversing queries, which is then executed on a graph data store, which is then returned to the user.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the translation of SPARQL to Gremlin is possible and can be used to query graph databases.
the translation from SPARQL to Gremlin path queries is possible, but the translation from SPQRL to a Gremlin traversal is not possible.
Gremlin is a powerful language to query graph databases.
